_comment: Unacknowledged step-internal FAIL/MISSING reports across the PUBLISHED (git-tracked) run trees — a run tree being any directory that owns a tracked reports/**/*.json, which is what the gate can read, NOT a directory whose name matches a convention (vibe-ic#1223). MAY ONLY SHRINK UNDER A FIXED POPULATION — each one is a report declaring FAIL that no waiver and no orchestrator record names. The wrong repair is to loosen the matcher until the number falls (vibe-ic#693). `corpus_population` is the root this count was taken over and is part of the record: the gate refuses to ratchet a count from one population against a sweep of another.
_withdrawn_comment: Findings that left findings_total because their run left the published corpus (or stopped carrying a reports/ tree), NOT because anyone examined them (vibe-ic#1202). Recorded so a fall in findings_total can never be read as debt paid. These reports still declare FAIL. NOT part of findings_total and not a ceiling on anything — the ratchet is over the published corpus only.

withdrawal_provenance.reason: The published corpus moved to its own repository (vibe-ic v1.10.56) and that repository's opening publish filter kept only the cells that pass and conform. Measured, not assumed: its opening snapshot 6ca1e29 reproduces this baseline exactly — 16 run trees swept, 16 with a reports/ tree, 22 findings, the same per_run map — and its next commit ac2ae51 removed 12 of those 16: one cell whose own RESULT.md says FAIL and which benchmark_evidence_structure_check exits 1 on, and 11 working trees (clean_run_* directories, and loose phase/reports/sim/steps trees sitting directly under an IC) that PUBLISHING.md's layout does not permit. Nine of the 12 carried the 21 findings withdrawn here; the other three were examined and clean. NOT DELETED AS SETTLED, AND NOT EXAMINED: every one of those reports still declares FAIL and is readable in that snapshot. The two u_hawaii_adc/clean_run_* entries already on the ledger left earlier and for a different reason — inside vibe-ic, by losing their reports/ tree; see _withdrawn_provenance.

_withdrawn_provenance: Re-derived from git, not re-measured: 94c7572aa moved this file 7 -> 5 and its diff shows both sha256 runs UNCHANGED (2 and 3) while both u_hawaii_adc runs left. Zero repaired, two withdrawn. Replaying that commit's parent baseline through the fixed gate against the corpus at 75776dbbb reproduces exactly these two entries.
